text.en:
The AICO rate provide in Annex "A" shall be accorded to
the AICO entity from Thailand (Denso (Thailand) Co. Ltd. upon the effectivity of
this Executive Order.

The articles specifically listed in the aforesaid Annex "A"
which are entered or withdrawn from warehouses in the Philippines for
consumption shall pay the applicable AICO preferential tariff rates specified
under Sections 1 hereof, subject to qualification under the Rules of Origin for the
CEPT, as evidenced by the Certificate of Origin - Form "D"

This Executive Order shall take effect fifteen (15) days
following its complete publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation in
the Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of May
Lord, Two Thousand and Six.
in the year of Our
glaris Areas
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
